notes.title: Banker Simulator - Developer Diary #5
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/79f24103bab3b4891a6098a0aaf104fc2052fd28.jpg"][/img][/p][h1][b]Hello Bankers! 💼[/b][/h1][p]The Banker Simulator universe keeps expanding.[/p][p]After the Prologue release, we worked tirelessly and added many new features based on your feedback.[/p][p]With new systems, more freedom, a deeper experience, and plenty of money-printing opportunities, Banker Simulator now offers a much richer gameplay experience.[/p][p]Let’s take a look at what has changed and what’s coming next.[/p][h2]🔧 [b]Worker system[/b][/h2][p]Now you can hire helpers to work at the bank: cleaners, security guards, repairmen, and money printers.[/p][p]Everything runs automatically—your job is just to manage it all.[/p][h2]💥 [b]Security is tougher now[/b][/h2][p]Dealing with graffiti vandals is a thing of the past. Security intervenes immediately and keeps the bank’s reputation intact.[/p][h2]🧹 [b]Cleaner updated[/b][/h2][p]Everything from cigarette butts to graffiti on the walls gets cleaned.[/p][p]Your bank stays spotless![/p][h2]🪑 [b]Desk and cashier limits removed[/b][/h2][p]Buy as many desks as your money allows.[/p][p]Hire as many cashiers as you want to speed up operations.[/p][h2]🛠️ [b]Repairman system[/b][/h2][p]Machine breakdowns are no longer an issue.[/p][p]Hire a repairman and get things fixed quickly.[/p][h2]💰 [b]Money-printing employee[/b][/h2][p]No need to handle everything yourself.[/p][p]Your money-printing staff runs the machines—you just place cargo orders.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/4a190e6c7675b06584bdc8a5afd08a3f7792b19b.gif"][/img][/p][h2]💵 [b]Big updates to the money-printing system[/b][/h2][p]Machines now come in three tiers: Basic, Pro, and Ultra.[/p][p]Upgrade them to improve efficiency.[/p][h2]💵 [b]New banknotes[/b][/h2][p]You can now print $100 bills.[/p][p]Time to fill those vaults![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/02806170d2aa6e3610084c3a8f290235f5bf6ffb.gif"][/img][/p][h2]🔌 [b]Circuit breaker sabotage[/b][/h2][p]When the power goes out, operations slow down.[/p][p]Turn the power back on and restore the system.[/p][h2]🔥 [b]Bank fire and second branch[/b][/h2][p]After a fire, you can move to a brand-new bank.[/p][p]A fresh start awaits![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/1a7d1dea6441588874746b5323f014f0edce162c.gif"][/img][/p][h2]📦 [b]Invoice tracking[/b][/h2][p]Manage your bills and take your banking experience to the next level.[/p][h2]🏚️ [b]Improved foreclosure system[/b][/h2][p]New houses and hidden valuables have been added.[/p][p]Foreclosure operations are now more exciting.[/p][h2]📈 [b]Expanded stock market[/b][/h2][p]New companies bring bigger opportunities.[/p][p]Invest wisely and increase your profits.[/p][h2]🔧 [b]General improvements[/b][/h2][p]✅ Bug fixes
✅ Performance and optimization improvements
✅ Updated task system
✅ Refined code structure[/p][h2]🚧 [b]Coming soon[/b][/h2][p]💳 Credit card sales (with NPC dialogues)
👮‍♂️ Advanced police system
📖 Story expansion
📝 Deeper task mechanics
🏆 Achievements and much more[/p][p]🎮 Banker Simulator continues to grow into a rich and immersive experience.[/p][p]As you play, we keep building. Your support means everything to us.  [/p][p]Wishlist Now!   [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3393240/Banker_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

investment systems, credit evaluations, employee management, lifestyle elements, and much more are now part of the game!

Banker Simulator is no longer just a bank management game it's a full simulation of strategy, risk analysis, and a prestige filled life.

And this is just the beginning... We'll be sharing the release date of the Prologue with you very soon!

It’s been almost two weeks since our last ''Developer Diary'', and we’ve been working non-stop to make the Banker Simulator Demo even better.

Now you can verify customer identities in the database to catch any suspicious transactions. 

Stay alertthey might try to fool you!

notes.title: Banker Simulator - Developer Diary #1
notes.notes:
[url=https://discord.gg/Qk2R329sEQ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/79f24103bab3b4891a6098a0aaf104fc2052fd28.jpg[/img]
[/url]

[h1][b]Hello Bankers![/b][/h1] 

In this development diary for Banker Simulator, we want to share the game's production process and the experiences we aim to offer players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/8f1ddefb1c7a1d79162c52c70208393aac8f7812.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Concept and Story! 📖 [/b][/h2] 

Once a seasoned bank manager, weighed down by years of accumulated fatigue and a recent economic collapse, he had lost both his job and his hope.

As he pondered how he had ruined his own life, a dilapidated bank building in one of the city's old neighborhoods caught his eye and sparked a glimmer of hope.

In this captivating adventure, join the journey of the former bank manager. Together, strive to restore the forgotten bank to its former glory while overcoming financial hardships, ethical dilemmas, and tests of character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/bc6a362562fa091ec41f902bf485b6aae35338dd.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Gameplay Mechanics 🎮 [/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Heart of the Bank: The Currency Cycle! 💰[/b][/h2]

Welcome to the core of banking where cash reigns supreme. Our latest game offers you the unique opportunity to simulate the complete lifecycle of money, from its creation to circulation.

[h3][b]Printing Money! 💵 [/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/df3ddb755c7c666b5fc033c17986fcea37d84efc.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Cut! ✂️[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/8fddba5356e5da276f4394a36214d0319b80e39a.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Wash! 🧺[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/d7271eec56a5a41d2da0ca566a02d1740e6e04d5.gif[/img]

[h2][b]The Challenges of Bank Management! 💼[/b][/h2] 

Dreaming of making a quick money? Better wake up and smell the coffee!

Especially if you're new to banking, financing a bank is challenging; the entire operational burden rests on your shoulders.

We've enhanced the realism and interactivity of this process by incorporating a teller system into our game. Make the right decisions to keep your bank afloat, and resist the siren call of quick profits that could once again bring your bank to the brink of collapse!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/7322c4e9e7f1cec43eeab52e09ad220b78b03647.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/5278771ad5249bb5bf8d2ac802b29e4c62a42b21.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Decorate Your Bank! 🖌️[/b][/h2]

Planning the perfect bank environment? It's time to strategize your layout!

Start by arranging customer seating to ensure comfort and accessibility, setting the stage for a welcoming and functional space. Let's dive into the essentials of creating an effective bank interior that meets the needs of both customers and staff.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/c76e324b1948878938d1ab88e747143570dd8aea.gif[/img]

notes.title: Banker Simulator Steam Next Fest: Meeting You in February 2025!
notes.notes:
[h1]A New Business Simulation Adventure: Banker Simulator, Steam Next Fest: Coming with a Demo in February 2025! [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/4b4f8973a8a6a688dd80b94423c435ba68738938.png[/img]

Dear gamers,

Are you ready to step into the shoes of a struggling banker looking for redemption? We are excited to introduce our brand new game Banker Simulator!

[h2][b]What is Banker Simulator? 🏦[/b][/h2] 

Banker Simulator is an exciting business simulation game that puts you in the role of a former banker who has lost it all. Rebuild your financial empire from the ground up, make tough decisions, and relive the thrilling highs and challenging lows of running a bank! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45367417/161e255ae96ffcac6b5455745ae23154637bfea6.gif[/img]

[h2][b]What’s Waiting for You? 📌 [/b][/h2]

[h2][b]Rebuild the Bank from Scratch! 🏗️[/b][/h2] 

Step by step, repair the rundown bank.

Fix broken desks, upgrade outdated equipment, and strategically place ATMs around the city to generate passive income. Customize everything from the bank's name and logo to its interior design it’s all up to your taste!
